definition_tar_lang: To realize too late that something you said in a supposedly private chat has already been captured and is now socially dangerous. It implies the sinking feeling of having lost control of your own words.

definition_tar_lang: To answer a direct question in a way that makes everything vaguer than before. Used for strategic ambiguity when someone wants to avoid commitment without explicitly refusing.

definition_tar_lang: The emotional excuse someone keeps wrapped around themselves to avoid growth, accountability, or difficult conversations. It is not just comfort; it is comfort weaponized into a lifestyle.
sentence_in_context: هر بار بحث جدی می‌شه، [MASK201]‌شو می‌کشه روش و غیبش می‌زنه.

definition_tar_lang: The delayed panic that hits when you suddenly realize how long you've been postponing something serious while pretending there's still plenty of time.

paragraph_in_context: امروز از صبح حوصله‌ی هیچ‌کس را نداشتم، ولی جلسه‌ی تیم را نمی‌شد کنسل کرد. پنج دقیقه مانده به شروع، رفتم آب به صورتم زدم و یک [MASK212]ِ سریع انجام دادم. جالب اینجاست که تا نیمه‌ی جلسه خودم هم باورم شده بود همه‌چیز روبه‌راه است. بعدش دوباره همان خستگی برگشت.

Five minutes before it started, I went and splashed water on my face and did a quick padkani.
